subject.title: [Bug]: Codex app-server session wedges indefinitely after a 429 rate-limit burst — terminal-idle watchdog still gated by `activeAppServerTurnRequests > 0` (regression/incomplete fix of #82681)

question: Should this issue remain open until a release containing https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102160 has live 429 evidence, or is current-main source and test proof enough to close it as implemented?
rationale: The source-level fix path is strong, but the latest human status comment explicitly asks for live confirmation on a release and no current release contains the stack.

options.title: Keep Live Verification Tracker
options.body: Keep this issue open until redacted live 429 evidence on a release build proves the shared-client wedge is retired.

options.title: Close As Current-Main Implemented
options.body: Close now based on current source, tests, and merged PR provenance, accepting that shipped-release proof will come later.

options.title: Split Timeout Policy Elsewhere
options.body: Keep this issue focused only on the 429 shared-client proof and leave terminal-idle timeout configurability to the existing timeout-policy tracker.

recommendation.title: Keep Live Verification Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until redacted live 429 evidence on a release build proves the shared-client wedge is retired.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the landed stack and the current live-verification status comment for this issue.
